Russian President Vladimir Putin brought his country's nuclear briefcase to China. Rare footage released by Russian state TV channel shows a naval officer accompanying Putin's delegation at the APEC summit carrying what is identified as the Russian nuclear command briefcase, known as the "Cheget". Traditionally carried by a naval officer, the Cheget is part of Russia's nuclear command-and-control system and is associated with the president's authority to authorise a nuclear strike.
